precision_replay.scope: Roots from two independently rebuilt source/eigenvector precisions. Low-polynomials fully isolated at m16,24,40,80,160; other low-vectors replay every high physical-strip root plus bounded pure-imaginary roots by rational Newton with convergence/distinctness checks. Newton counts are replayed roots, not low-polynomial completeness certificates. No source-zero seeds. Empirical replay, not an exact-ground interval certificate.
